blocked_by.description: Created BLOCKED: one or more dependencies not yet COMPLETE

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When `vendor/` directory does not exist, `composer install` runs automatically before the menu is shown.
If `composer install` fails (non-zero exit code), the script aborts with exit code 1.
The menu displays all 7 options (1-6 plus 0 for Exit) with colored option numbers.
Options 2, 4, 5, 6 invoke their respective Composer commands (`composer build`, `composer clear-caches`, `composer seed-tests`, `composer analyze`).
Option 3 prompts for a filter pattern; empty input runs `composer test`, non-empty runs `composer test-filter -- <pattern>`.
After any action completes, the menu redisplays (loop continues).
Invalid input (non-matching choice) is handled gracefully (re-prompts or shows an error message).
